Sinking slabs are raised via concrete lifting by filling in the spaces below. Unevenness or water problems are addressed by this procedure. A substantial cement and mud mixture is used in mud-jacking. A thin polyurethane foam is used. Concrete lifting typically costs less than replacing the entire slab.

We level uneven concrete on driveways, sidewalks, pool aprons, etc. If you have noticed concrete damage, we can give you a free inspection and offer you the solutions you need to get your concrete level. Changes in the soil can also make concrete sink and crack. If it gets too dry, it can shrink; if it gets too wet, it can heave. Shifting soil causes problems to concrete. We perform polyjacking for both residential and commercial properties.
